name: Contact Popover
author: MD.Muslim

sections.description:
Contact Popover is a lightweight and simple WordPress plugin that allows you to display your contact details inside a stylish popover. You can customize the button color, text color, popover content, and even the position of the button.

Features:
– Customizable contact information (Name, Phone, Email, Address, Website)
– Button color, text color, and position control (Top, Bottom, Left, Right)
– Lightweight and easy to use
– Shortcode support: [contpo_contact_popover]
– Admin settings page for easy customization
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/contpo-contact-popover directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Contact Popover under the WordPress admin menu to configure your settings.
  4. Use the shortcode [contpo_contact_popover] in any post or page where you want the popover button to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I display the contact popover?

Just use the shortcode [contpo_contact_popover] in any post, page, or widget.

Can I customize the button styles?

Yes! You can customize the button’s background color, text color, and position from the plugin settings page.
